title: Compose native input lifts with the query tree at conditional κ 0.00314980
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Compose PR #6349's four native input lifts with PR #6348's binary query tree. The complete conditional claim is **κ = 0.00314980**, up **0.00000047 (0.0149%)** from PR6348. This is a small composition gain; the donor's one-percent breakthrough target remains unmet.

The existing source and caller constructions are unchanged. The new work binds their interfaces and checks the complete composition. All four productive target debits occur at each of the 19 full calls. The caller has **70,542 paid jobs, 14,214 productive jobs and rank-mass surplus 808**. The raw crossing lies strictly in **(0.00314981300605, 0.00314981300606)**. The prior complete tree bill fails at the new claim.

Only `research/p104-input-lift-tree-composition/` is added. The selected frontier stays unchanged. All five inherited framework assumptions remain. No materialized uniform word, rounded multiplier, independent scientific acceptance or formal-kernel acceptance is claimed.

## Task and overlap

Base: canonical main `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`, refreshed before submission. Publication head: `466c812fe729ed540265eeaeabc5e4a71d3440c5`.

Task `joint-query-controller`; scope changed to the complete composition of two published results. Exact dependencies are PR6348 at `9894015d6f380206f990ad5fd14bc49bbd26b0d0` and PR6349 at `af7cb6c67f8fc7d82a2e4aee2dd2f07481bf6690`. Both fixed constructions are released. The active joint input-direction search in Discussion5645 is excluded.

[Canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5600#discussioncomment-19209322) and [scope handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5645#discussioncomment-19341992). Direct current comments, recent open PRs and cached overlap records were checked. Sparse notes, arbitrary unseen diffs and unpublished work remain coverage limits.

## Validation

On CPython 3.12.13, macOS 26.6.1 arm64, complete normal and optimized registered replays pass:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-input-lift-tree-composition
```

The replay checks regenerated source/caller bytes, all 799 input columns, 2,930 native maps with absolute phases, 7,904 caller contacts, the full invoice, two rational price engines, completion/compiler bounds and all 54 strict plus four functional outer predicates. Fourteen controls reject missing work, target debits and invalid source/caller operations.

Committed bytes and executable modes pass for all 28 package/input files. The official export covers all 17 live inputs. The complete optimized read-only export replay passes with empty PATH and no Git; all 29 files and 36 path modes remain unchanged. Actual source-word and price-literal mutations reject.

The optional full source-history preflight stopped because the checkout is shallow. All pins resolve at the canonical base, which is publication ancestry; no side-branch pin is used. Full history was not fetched. Hosted CI is pending. [Validation record](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/466c812fe729ed540265eeaeabc5e4a71d3440c5/research/p104-input-lift-tree-composition/VALIDATION.md).

## Open next questions

Independently check the unchanged main interface, independent helper inputs and complete signed changes. The active joint-input investigation can use this composition as a checked baseline. A larger gain still requires a new exact construction and its complete invoice; this package does not supply one. See TASK.json and PROOF.md.
